# Digital Doorway Marketing

> Digital Doorway Marketing designs and builds custom websites for local businesses (restaurants, salons, trades, clinics, gyms, shops, landscapers, and more) for $499 up front, or $49.99/month with a 12-month initial commitment. Either plan includes the first year of hosting, domain registration, SSL security, 5 business email addresses, local SEO, QR code generation, a professional audio welcome message, a CRM customized for the client's industry, and a digital business card. Promo videos are sold separately. Founded by Marv Reeves, based in Seattle, WA.

## The $499 website

- Price: two ways to pay. $499 up front (save $100 in year one), or $49.99/month with a 12-month initial commitment. Both include the first year (12 months) of hosting, domain registration, SSL security, 5 business email addresses, local SEO, QR code generation, a professional audio welcome message, a customized CRM, and a digital business card. Services continue at $49.99/month beginning in month 13 (the Business Bundle), or can be chosen individually. At Digital Doorway's regular prices that package is worth $1,277.75 ($749.95 for the seven core services, $419.40 for the CRM, and $108.40 for the digital business card).
- Included: custom design (not a template), mobile-first build, copywriting help, Google-ready SEO basics (titles, descriptions, speed, map listing hookup), contact forms and click-to-call, two rounds of changes, launch, and a walkthrough of the finished site. The client owns the site.
- CRM: set up for the client's industry, with stages, fields, and reminders that match how the business works (for example quotes and jobs for trades, appointments and rebooking for salons, inquiries and events for caterers). Website contact-form inquiries land in it automatically. Included for the first 12 months (a $419 value).
- Digital business card: a card at card.digitaldoorwaymarketing.com/name with one-tap save to contacts, photo, video, voice greeting, QR code sharing, an Exchange contact form that sends leads to the CRM, and view/save stats. Included for the first 12 months (a $108 value), then in the Business Bundle or $4.95/month.
- Promo videos (sold separately, not part of the $499 package): a professionally scripted, narrated, and edited video for the website, social media, and Google profile, the client's to keep. 15 seconds $249, 30 seconds $399, 60 seconds $599, 90 seconds $799, one-time. Can be added to a website order at checkout or ordered on its own.
- Every client gets more than one design direction to choose from.
- Payment: online at checkout on the website, through Square (card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay).

## After the first year (optional)

- Business Bundle: $49.99/month, or $539.89/year paid up front (10% off). Domain, hosting, SSL security, 5 business email accounts, local SEO, QR codes, the audio welcome message, the customized CRM, and the digital business card.
- Or individually: website hosting $14.95/month, domain name registration $9.95/year, SSL security $5.95/month, 5 professional email addresses $59/year, local SEO $19.95/month, QR code generation $5.95/month, audio welcome message $9.95/month, customized CRM $34.95/month, digital business card $4.95/month. Promo videos are sold separately.
- Services and promo videos can be bought individually on the pricing page (https://digitaldoorwaymarketing.com/pricing/#buy-services) through Square.

## How it works

1. Tell us about your business (a short conversation).
2. We design your site.
3. You say what to change (two rounds).
4. We launch it, with hosting, your domain, SSL, business email, local SEO, QR codes, your audio welcome message, your CRM, and your digital business card set up.
